line.en: europa league, league phase, kick-off 20:00 at celtic park. thursday is bonfire night, so the streets will be busy; leave time to get in.
line.de: europa league, ligaphase, anpfiff 20:00 im celtic park. donnerstag ist bonfire night, die straßen sind voll; plane den weg früh ein.
line.tr: avrupa ligi, lig aşaması, başlama 20:00, celtic park. perşembe bonfire night, sokaklar kalabalık olur; yola erken çık.

sparks.why: Celtic v Besiktas, UEFA Europa League league phase, Thu 5 Nov at 20:00 UK time at Celtic Park, per the foresportia and rateyourseats listings, which agree on 8pm; the SPFL and What's On Glasgow pages could not be read.
